data.summary: The two‑week plan front‑loads the weak Unit 8 material, using the live class in week 1 and focused practice, then uses week 2 for mixed review and timed FR practice across all units to solidify knowledge before the exam.

weeks.focus: Introduce and practice Acids and Bases (Unit 8) and reinforce core concepts.
tasks: Watch the live Class 9100 (covers 8.1, 8.2) and take detailed notes (1 hour).
Do 15 free‑response questions on strong acid/base pH calculations, then check answers with the scoring guide (1.5 hours).
Complete 10 practice problems on identifying acids/bases and writing net ionic equations (1 hour).
Review atomic structure (1.5 hours): read 1.5 sections, then complete 5 concept‑check questions on electron configuration.
Practice drawing Lewis structures for common acids/bases (2.5 hours): complete 8 problems and self‑grade using the answer key.

weeks.focus: Mixed review and timed practice of all units.
tasks: Set a 45‑minute timer and complete a full‑length AP Chemistry free‑response section (all units). Mark against the official scoring guide (1 hour).
Do a mixed‑topic worksheet: 5 questions each on stoichiometry, gas law, equilibrium constant, and Gibbs free energy (2 hours).
Review notes from week 1 on acids/bases; redo 5 missed FR questions and explain each step (1 hour).
Watch a 30‑minute recap video on thermochemistry and kinetics, then solve 6 related problems (1 hour).
Create a one‑page concept map linking each unit’s key ideas to help with quick recall (0.5 hour).
Spend the final 1.5 hours doing timed multiple‑choice practice (AP‑style) focusing on weaker areas identified in week 1.

data.final_week_advice: In the final week before the exam, focus on timed full‑section practice, review any remaining weak spots, and ensure you get adequate rest the night before the test.
